description: Preliminary strength check of steel members to AISC 360-16 LRFD under the forces you give: available strengths and the demand-to-capacity ratio D/C of each member, the governing limit state and every step with its clause. Covers compression (flexural, torsional and local buckling, E3/E4/E7), tension yielding (D2), bending about both axes with lateral-torsional and local buckling (F2, F3, F6, F7, F8; Cb given or from the moment diagram, 1.0 for cantilevers), shear (G2.1, G4, G5, G6) and the H1-1 interaction, for I-sections (IPE, HEA, HEB, or dimensions: rolled when a root radius r > 0 is given, welded when r = 0 or "built_up": true), rectangular and square hollow sections (RHS/SHS) and round hollow sections (CHS), HSS design wall thickness 0.93t (B4.2). Steel grades ASTM A992, A36, A572 Gr. 50, A500 Gr. C, A53 Gr. B, or Fy; EN S235-S355 (EN 10025, EN 10219 as S..H) are checked with the AISC equations by analogy, since AISC 360-16 approves ASTM materials (A3.1a). The forces are taken as given: they must include second-order effects, from the direct analysis method of Chapter C or, with K from a stability analysis, the effective length method (analyze_frame gives elastic second-order forces without notional loads or stiffness reduction, and its result already has a member check of every member); the effective lengths are yours. Not covered (reported): webs noncompact or slender in flexure for I-sections, torsion, net-section rupture, connections, seismic provisions, fire. Up to 50 members per call; nothing is stored.

Cb.description: Lateral-torsional buckling modification factor (default 1.0, or from cb_moments_kNm; F1-1 limited to 3.0 by this tool). Use 1.0 for a cantilever with an unbraced free end (F1).

Lb_m.description: Unbraced length for lateral-torsional buckling, m (default L).

Lcx_m.description: Effective length for buckling about the strong axis, Lc = K L, m (default L).

Lcy_m.description: Effective length for buckling about the weak axis, m (default L).

Lcz_m.description: Effective length for torsional buckling, m (default L, independent of Lcy).

M_major_kNm.description: Required moment about the strong axis, kNm.

M_minor_kNm.description: Required moment about the weak axis, kNm.

N_kN.description: Required axial force, kN: tension positive, compression negative.

T_kNm.description: Torsion, kNm: not checked, only flagged.

V_major_kN.description: Required shear parallel to the web (with strong-axis bending), kN.

V_minor_kN.description: Required shear in the other direction, kN.

cantilever.description: true for a cantilever with an unbraced free end: Cb = 1.0 (F1).

cb_moments_kNm.description: [Mmax, MA, MB, MC] of the unbraced segment (F1-1) to compute Cb.

grade.description: Steel grade (default S355). EN Fy by thickness to EN 1993-1-1 Table 3.1.

section.description: A name: "IPE 300", "HEA 200", "HEB 400", "SHS 100x100x5", "RHS 200x100x6", "CHS 139.7x5"; or dimensions in mm: {"shape":"I","h":..,"b":..,"tw":..,"tf":..,"r":..} (r = 0 or "built_up": true = welded), {"shape":"RHS","h":..,"b":..,"t":..}, {"shape":"CHS","D":..,"t":..}.
